label: French Fly
description: A French fly adds an extra inner tab that extends across from the waistband and fastens with a hidden button inside the fly. This anchors the waistband closed and flat, taking strain off the main closure and preventing the front from pulling open. It is a mark of quality construction on better tailored trousers.
